clues.text: God told Moses to have the ark of the Testimony built from this wood and overlaid with pure gold.
In the tabernacle, the veil before the Most Holy Place hung on four gold-covered posts of this wood.
The tabernacle table that held the Bread of the Presence before the LORD was made of this wood.
Bezalel built the square altar of burnt offering from this wood, then overlaid it with bronze.
The altar where Aaron burned fragrant incense every morning was made from this wood and covered in gold.
The upright frames of the tabernacle, each ten cubits long, were cut from this wood.
When Moses asked Israel for gifts for the tabernacle, everyone who had this wood brought it.
